# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4727

# Review — PAN-4727
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — `pan skills pack gc` deletes a registered gstack pack's `state/` and `render/` when `~/.overdeck/config.yaml` fails to parse (reproduced)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4727-review-4e20ea4d
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4727/.pan/review/agent-pan-4727-review-4e20ea4d/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4727 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4727
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4735
- HEAD reviewed: 4e20ea4de2fd82ca03feb0802e9d8bf297fdd7a1 (working tree clean except the xbrief continue file)
- Base / prior cycle SHA: prior review agent-pan-4727-review-0749e890 at 0749e8905f7 (CHANGES REQUESTED)

## Prior-cycle verification
| Prior item | Status at 4e20ea4 | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blocker: direct `rm` of Codex caches under `~/.overdeck/agents` tripped `lint:agent-dir-removal` | **Fixed** | `41f533c7`: new door `removeCodexPluginCaches()` in `src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts` (name pattern check, skips symlinks, `assertContained` on the realpath); `mount.ts` calls it. CI `lint-group (core)` and `lint` pass; local guard passes; state-dir-removal.test covers it. |
| Advisory 1: update probed bun before the no-change return | Fixed | `70c7c49b`: `runtimePreview` now runs after the early return and before `confirm`, so FR-10 still holds; sources.test case added. |
| Advisory 4: project `.gstack/` listing keyed on literal id | Fixed | `skillsPackRemoveCommand` reads the entry's adapter before removal; skills.test case added. |
| Advisory 5: render gc ignored renders live mounts use | Fixed | Mounts record `.overdeck-render-root`; `gcMounts` returns `referencedMounts`; `renderRootsUsedBy` builds a keep set; `buildMount` touches the render on build and reuse. Path strings match: both sides derive from `join(getOverdeckHome(), 'packs', id, 'render', commit)`. mount/render tests added. |
| Advisories 2, 3, 6, 7 | Unchanged, still advisory | See below. Advisory 3 (gc vs in-progress add) is now subsumed by the blocker's root cause. |

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] gc removes a registered runtime pack's state when the registry cannot be read — `src/cli/commands/skills.ts:478` with `src/lib/skill-packs/render.ts` `gcPackRenders()`
- Severity: ! (data loss: gstack's `state/` holds its config, sessions, learnings, project reports and plans, and nothing can rebuild it)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope (WI-O8 `gstack-gc-renders`, FR-15). FR-15 says gc removes `render/`/`state/` of *unregistered* pack ids; the code treats "the registry could not be read" as "unregistered".
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `skillsPackGcCommand()` builds `registered` from `listPacks()`. `listPacks()` (`src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts:101`) returns `[]` when `config.yaml` fails to parse, and silently drops any entry `toEntry()` rejects (bad commit, unknown adapter value). `gcPackRenders()` then sees no trusted commit for `gstack` and runs `rm -rf` on `packs/gstack/render` and `packs/gstack/state`. The same root cause also covers the race from last cycle's advisory 3: an `add` that is still rendering (up to 10 minutes, before `writePackEntry`) loses its `render/` and `state/` to a concurrent gc.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected gc to keep a registered pack's state, or to refuse when it cannot tell. Observed: the state dir is deleted and gc reports it as an orphan. One bad indent from a hand edit of the global config is enough. The operator loses all gstack learnings and reports with no warning beyond a YAML error printed by another loader.
- Evidence (runtime reproduction, isolated scratch `OVERDECK_HOME`, the built CLI `node dist/cli/index.js`, whose orphan-state branch is unchanged at this head):
  - `config.yaml` registers `skills.packs.gstack` (valid url/ref/40-hex commit), plus one mis-indented line elsewhere in the file.
  - `packs/gstack/state/{learnings.jsonl,config.yaml}` and `packs/gstack/render/<commit>/` exist.
  - `pan skills pack gc` → `Removed 0 mount(s), 0 dangling launch link(s), 0 stale render(s) and 1 orphaned pack state dir(s).`, exit 0. Afterwards `packs/gstack/` is empty: `state/` and `render/` are gone.
  - Limitation: the probe uses the dist built at 13:59 (it predates `70c7c49b`'s keep set, which does not touch the orphan branch). CodeRabbit flagged the same issue (Major, on `src/cli/commands/skills.ts`); I verified it independently.
- Why the earlier cycle missed it: cycle 1 assessed only the gc/add race (advisory 3) and did not trace that `listPacks()` swallows parse errors and malformed entries. That turns a rare race into a one-typo trigger, and the consequence is non-rebuildable state, so it is a blocker.
- Fix: read the registry strictly for gc's orphan pass. If the global config does not parse, skip orphan `render/`/`state/` removal entirely (still run mount gc and the age-based removal of non-trusted renders only for ids that parsed). Treat an id as registered whenever raw `skills.packs` holds a key for it, even when `toEntry()` rejects the entry. Optionally also skip an id whose `render/` or `state/` mtime is younger than `maxAgeMs`, which closes the add race. Add a test with an unparsable config and one with a malformed gstack entry, both asserting `state/` survives.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. **~ One `rm` failure aborts the remove sweep** (CodeRabbit, minor, `src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts` `removePackFromMounts`). An `EACCES`/`EBUSY` on one mount rejects the sweep after `removePack` has already unregistered the pack, and the CLI ends with an unhandled error. It can be recovered: rerunning `pan skills pack remove <id>` runs the sweep again before it exits with "not registered". Collecting failures and exiting non-zero would make the outcome clear.
2. **? Every launch and catalog read walks the whole gstack extraction** (carried over from cycle 1, advisory 2). `listPackCatalog()` → `readPackManifest(..., 'gstack-runtime')` lists executables across the whole tree. Bounded (a few thousand files, async); only the consent preview needs the list.
3. **? Mounts built before `70c7c49b` lack `.overdeck-render-root`.** The mount hash did not change (`GSTACK_RENDER_VERSION` is still 1), so such a mount is reused without the file, and gc protects its render only through mtime. This affects only pre-release homes such as the live-acceptance isolated home; no shipped install has one.
4. **Process note** (carried over): the `overdeck/test` status text "typecheck+lint" overstates what the local gate runs.
5. **Traceability** (carried over): the hand-run acceptance set `GSTACK_SESSION_KIND=spawned` in a `claude -p` command; `src` never sets it (non-goal 4 holds).

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger (merge-base…4e20ea4; delta since 0749e89 in bold)
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| **`src/lib/agents/state-dir-removal.ts`** | Reviewed: new door is narrow (one cache dir per agent home), validates names, refuses symlinks and escapes. |
| **`src/lib/skill-packs/mount.ts`** | Reviewed: door call, render-root marker file, render touch on build/reuse, `referencedMounts`, `renderRootsUsedBy`. Advisories 1, 3. |
| **`src/lib/skill-packs/render.ts`** | Reviewed: `keep` set honored before the age check; orphan branch → **blocker**. |
| **`src/lib/skill-packs/sources.ts`** | Reviewed: runtime preview moved after the no-change return, still before consent. |
| **`src/cli/commands/skills.ts`** | Reviewed: remove reads the adapter first; gc passes the keep set; registry read → **blocker**. |
| **`features/skills.mdx`** | Reviewed: gc wording matches the keep-set behaviour. |
| `src/lib/skill-packs/{gstack,adapters}.ts`, `src/lib/skill-overrides/{catalog,launch}.ts`, `packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts`, `docs/USAGE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` | Unchanged since cycle 1; cycle-1 review stands. |
| Tests: `state-dir-removal.test.ts`, `mount.test.ts`, `render.test.ts`, `sources.test.ts`, `skills.test.ts` (delta) plus `adapters`, `gstack`, `launch` tests | Reviewed; the new cases map to each fix. No test covers an unreadable registry (the blocker). |
| `.pan/**` plan/spec/checkpoint/continue files | Not applicable as code. |
| Merge of `origin/main` (`4e20ea4`) | Brought only `.pan` backlog-sequence commits into the diff against 0749e89; no source conflicts. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** one blocker (gc data loss); prior blocker fixed; advisories 1 and 3.
- **Security:** the new door adds containment and symlink refusal; nothing reaches it from outside. No finding.
- **Performance:** `touchRenderRoots` adds one `utimes` per runtime pack per launch, which is negligible. Advisory 2 carried over.
- **Requirements / UX:** FR-15 is unmet as specified (state of a registered pack can be removed). All other FR/NFR rows stand as recorded in cycle 1, and FR-10, FR-14 and FR-15's keep behaviour were re-checked against the delta.

### Requirement-to-evidence matrix (delta only; other rows unchanged from cycle 1)
| Req | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-10 | Met | Runtime check still precedes `confirm` in add and update; sources.test. |
| FR-14 | Met | Door-based sweep; mount/skills/state-dir-removal tests; CI core lint green. |
| FR-15 | **Unmet** | Reproduced deletion of a registered pack's `state/` (blocker). Keep-set part met. |
| NFR-3 | Met | `skill-packs` imports `agents/state-dir-removal`, not `skill-overrides`; `lint:circular` passes. |
| NFR-4 | Met | `lint:file-size` passes. |

## Verification
- CI on 4e20ea4: `lint` ✓, `lint-group (core|effect|skills|state)` ✓ (effect covers `lint:effect-diagnostics`), `build (22)` ✓, `test-e2e` ✓, shards 1/3/4 ✓, clean-install smoke ✓, prompt-trailer ✓, CodeRabbit ✓. `test-shard (2/4)` / `test` ✗: the only failing file is `tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts` (529 other files and 5638 tests passed). That spec came from main (PAN-4650, `8d26b6fb84`), and main's own latest CI run at `8d26b6fb84` also concluded `failure`. It is not caused by this PR.
- Local focused run: `npx vitest run src/lib/skill-packs/__tests__/ src/lib/agents/__tests__/state-dir-removal.test.ts src/cli/commands/__tests__/skills.test.ts src/lib/skill-overrides/__tests__/launch.test.ts` → 9 files, 214 tests passed.
- Local lints: `guard-agent-dir-removal.sh` ✓, `lint:circular` ✓, `lint:file-size` ✓.
- Runtime probe: the gc reproduction above, run in an isolated scratch `OVERDECK_HOME` under the session scratchpad. No live operator state was touched.

## Scope Note
The remaining `test` red comes from main's PAN-4650 e2e spec. It will stay red on every PR until main fixes or quarantines that spec.
